name: qubits-and-gates
description: Use this skill when the user says 'qubit', 'Bloch sphere', 'superposition', 'Hadamard', 'Pauli X Y Z', 'CNOT', 'phase gate', 'T gate', 'rotation gates', 'universal gate set', 'unitary matrix', 'measurement basis'. Explains qubit states, measurement, single- and two-qubit gates with exact matrices and identities, universality (Clifford+T), and verifies them with Qiskit's quantum_info tools. Do NOT use for: entanglement protocols (quantum-computing/quantum-entanglement), algorithm design (quantum-computing/quantum-algorithms), or hardware/QEC topics (quantum-computing/quantum-error-correction).
